why: I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief. Item 2 is met: Check 2 runs `node bin/greet.js Ada` at the PR head and at the base commit and compares them ("identical to the base's output"). Item 1 is not met. Check 4 reads the live page with `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and checks merge state with `gh pr view`. It never checks at the PR head the things that will publish the page: it doesn't confirm that docs/index.md lists --shout or that .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. pages.yml comes up only as something to cite when the line "cannot be tested", not as something to inspect. The check still treats the live page as the real test, so it fails the trap.
